mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market overheating that triggers inflationary pressures and Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has been below 3.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing strength that supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that forces the Fed to accelerate rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor markets that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals tight labor markets with strong consumer spending, accelerating economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.
